phase1.explanation:
🦀 **Testing is built into Rust.**

**Test attributes:**

| Attribute | Use |
|-----------|-----|
| `#[test]` | Marks a test function |
| `#[cfg(test)]` | Only compile when testing |
| `#[should_panic]` | Test that should panic |
| `#[ignore]` | Skip a test |

**Assertion macros:**

| Macro | Use |
|-------|-----|
| `assert!(condition)` | Check condition |
| `assert_eq!(a, b)` | Check equality |
| `assert_ne!(a, b)` | Check inequality |
| `assert_matches!(a, b)` | Check pattern |

**Rust-chan says:**
"Testing is essential. Write tests for every function."

**Test organization:**
| Type | Location |
|------|----------|
| Unit tests | In the same file |
| Integration tests | `tests/` directory |
| Documentation tests | In doc comments |
